findings.title: Write lock does not re-check cache, so waiters reload and can clear it
findings.body: GetWebAssets copies entryPointAssetsCache under a read lock, drops that lock, and only then takes the write lock. It never looks at the cache again after Lock. Every caller that observed a nil cache—the concurrent first requests this change is meant to protect—runs the manifest load while holding the exclusive lock and then unconditionally assigns entryPointAssetsCache = result. A later waiter whose load fails stores nil and wipes an entry an earlier waiter already published, so following non-dev calls miss the cache and reload. Even when every load succeeds, the missing re-check serializes a full disk read per waiter instead of returning the value the first loader stored. After acquiring the write lock, return the existing cache when Env is not Dev and it is already set, and do not replace a populated cache with a failed nil result.
